{{DISPLAYTITLE:Toughskin (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:FFTA-spr-toughskin.gif|left]]
[[File:FFTA - Toughskin Portrait.png|right]]
{{Quote|Monster with skin so tough it doesn't feel swords.|Description}}
The '''Toughskin''' in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' is a green turtle-like creature with a sword sticking out of its back. It has an extremely high Defense stat, so magic spells are much more effective compared to physical attacks. Its Resonance ability can also disable the weapons used by most physically orientated jobs, further necessitating the use of magic.

Toughskins can be dangerous against physical units with low MP, as it can use [[Matra Magic]] to invert the HP and MP of a target. To avoid this attack, it is best to keep a distance by using long-range bows and magic. Matra Magic can also be learned by the Blue Mage job as a Blue Magic ability. The Toughskin has an even hardier lavender cousin, the [[Blade Biter (Tactics Advance)|Blade Biter]].

!Turf Defense Mission: Help Nubs!
|Two Toughskins appear here, on opposite sides of the battlefield. It helps to have two units with Black Magic or an instant KO ability.

!Turf Defense Mission: Help Nargai!
|The Toughskin here can be KO'd with a strong Ice spell on the first turn if the [[Black Mage (Tactics Advance)|Black Mage]] is placed on the northeastern corner of the starting block.

!Mission #058: Royal Ruins
|The Toughskin here is a guardian of the ancient Ruins. Players can use Phantasm Skills to bypass the monsters and destroy the statues.
|-
!Mission #012: Jagd Hunt
|The Toughskin in the back corner of the arena should be dealt with after the four clan members in front of the party are all KO'd.
